<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Hiring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="New Hire Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Hiring">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NeedIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyNeed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectScreenResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PhoneInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteForInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewFormat_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InPersonInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VirtualInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewFormat_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCandidate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExtendOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Negotiation_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateSalary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Negotiation_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OfferAccepted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompletePaperwork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrientNewHire</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TrainNewHire</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Integrated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for new hire identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeed" name="Identify need for new hire">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="Post job description on job boards">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectScreenResumes" name="Collect and screen resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterview" name="Conduct initial phone interviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteForInterview" name="Invite selected candidates for interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Split" name="Candidate's interview preference?" default="Flow_10">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Join" name="Interview completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidate" name="Choose candidate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation_Split" name="Salary negotiation takes place?" default="Flow_18">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation_Join" name="Offer terms settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrientNewHire" name="Conduct orientation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrainNewHire" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated into team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CollectScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterview" targetRef="Task_InviteForInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InviteForInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="In-person" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Split" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${candidatePreference == 'in-person'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Virtual" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Split" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${candidatePreference == 'virtual'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Other" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Split" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat_Join" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Split" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="No negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation_Join" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Event_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_OrientNewHire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_OrientNewHire" targetRef="Task_TrainNewHire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_TrainNewHire" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
